disposition.reason: A neighbor appealed the Village of Woodstock DRB's conditional use approval for fencing, goutweed replacement and removal of a maple tree at an existing house: a municipal appeal, but about landscaping and accessory work, not new housing.

evidence.quote: seek conditional use approval to install fencing, remove and replace goutweed with conservation mix, and remove a hollowed out sugar maple tree on their property.
Neighboring landowner Jennifer Falvey timely appealed that decision to this Court
Applicants Kevin and Diane Dugan own the house and property located at 37 Elm Street

judgments.note: Appeal of a DRB conditional use approval (municipal appeal = yes) for fencing, landscaping and a vent at an existing house; the disputed items were a terrace, fire pit and pathway. Accessory work at a house is not new housing, so excluded.

history.note: Excluded: neighbor appeal of fencing/landscaping approval at an existing house; no new housing.
